task: Implement RetryPolicy.decide and Backoff.delayAfter. maxAttempts is the TOTAL number of attempts, the initial one included. decide(failedAttempts, error): failedAttempts is how many attempts have already been made and failed (1 = only the initial attempt); a null error or a failedAttempts outside 1..maxAttempts throws IllegalArgumentException. Retry only if the error is an instance of one of the configured transient error types AND failedAttempts < maxAttempts; the delay is then backoff.delayAfter(failedAttempts). Otherwise return no retry with Duration.ZERO. Backoff.delayAfter(n) (n < 1 throws IllegalArgumentException) returns base * 2^(n-1), capped at max; it must never overflow or return a negative value or one above max, for any n up to Integer.MAX_VALUE. No sleeping, no I/O.

proposal.summary: Implemented RetryPolicy.decide with validation and transient-type check, and Backoff.delayAfter with overflow-safe capped exponential doubling.
